items.title: After a yearslong slump, China's real estate market may be set for a turnaround
items.summary: BEIJING — An end is in sight for China's yearslong property market slump, S&P Global Ratings analysts said in a report distributed Thursday.

items.title: Huawei doubles down on smartphones as EV sales slow
items.summary: BEIJING — Faced with a slowdown in the smartphone and car markets, Huawei's consumer business is choosing to focus on phones with homegrown chips.

items.title: Fed officials see another hike coming, but no sign as to when, minutes show
items.summary: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday released minutes from its Sept. 15-16 policy meeting.

items.title: Why AI is both the hope and the hazard for world leaders, according to IMF chief Georgieva
items.summary: SINGAPORE — The technology that investors and governments are counting on to lift the global economy is also adding pressure that threatens growth, the head of the International Monetary Fund said, urging policymakers to stop delaying painful choices on debt.

items.title: Inflation fears on the rise as one-year outlook in Fed survey hits highest level since May 2023
items.summary: Inflation fears intensified in September, pushing the near-term outlook in the New York Federal Reserve's monthly survey to its highest level in nearly 3½ years.

items.title: ICE came to town and left behind weakened economies
items.summary: MINNEAPOLIS — Operation Metro Surge has been over for months. The same can't be said for the crisis facing Daniel Hernandez's Colonial Market grocery stores.

items.title: India’s central bank hikes rates for the first time since 2023 as inflation risks build
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India on Wednesday raised interest rates for the first time since 2023, joining several major central banks in tightening monetary policy to arrest accelerating inflation.
